scripts.verify: npm run architecture && npm run build -w @machbar/shared && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:apps
scripts.build: npm run build -w @machbar/shared && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @machbar/web && npm run build -w @machbar/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @machbar/api" "npm run dev -w @machbar/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck:e2e
